title: Proper plaintiff.
bodyText:
In a derivative action for a limited liability company, the plaintiff shall be a member of the company when the action is commenced, and:

(1) Shall have been a member at the time of the transaction of which the plaintiff complains; or

(2) The plaintiff's status as a member shall have devolved upon the plaintiff by operation of law or pursuant to the terms of the operating agreement from a person who was a member at the time of the transaction.
bodyHtml:
[§428-1102]  Proper plaintiff.  In a derivative action for a limited liability company, the plaintiff shall be a member of the company when the action is commenced, and:

     (1)  Shall have been a member at the time of the transaction of which the plaintiff complains; or

     (2)  The plaintiff's status as a member shall have devolved upon the plaintiff by operation of law or pursuant to the terms of the operating agreement from a person who was a member at the time of the transaction. [L 1996, c 92, pt of §1]
